extracted.intended_audience: professionals, employers, credential verifiers, and members of professional bodies seeking SAQA registration information
extracted.subtask_description: A registry record from the South African Qualifications Authority for a professional body (here: PRISA), listing identification, recognition status and dates, registered professional designations, and contact/web details; includes reproduction/attribution rules for the registry content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public property and reproduction/attribution rules
rubrics_metrics.description: The information on Professional Bodies and Professional Designations on the National Qualifications Framework is public property. Thus the only payment that can be made for it is for service and reproduction. It is illegal to sell this material for profit. If the material is reproduced or quoted, the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) should be acknowledged as the source.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not sell SAQA registry material for profit; permitted payments are limited to service and reproduction. Any reproduction or quotation must acknowledge SAQA as the source.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional body identification
rubrics_metrics.description: PROFESSIONAL BODY: PRISA - Public Relations Institute of Southern Africa; PROFESSIONAL BODY ID 839
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registry entries include the official name of the professional body and a unique numeric Professional Body ID to identify the organization in SAQA records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional body status and SAQA recognition details
rubrics_metrics.description: PROFESSIONAL BODY STATUS: Recognition Renewed / Non-Statutory; SAQA DECISION NUMBER: SAQA 13144/24; RECOGNITION START DATE: 2023-07-27; RECOGNITION END DATE: 2028-07-26
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Records specify whether recognition is statutory or non-statutory, whether recognition has been renewed, the SAQA decision number authorizing recognition, and the exact start and end dates of the recognition period. These fields are used to verify current recognition status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registered professional designations
rubrics_metrics.description: REGISTERED PROFESSIONAL DESIGNATIONS: Designation ID 437 — PRP - Public Relations Practitioner; 438 — CPRP - Chartered Public Relations Practitioner; 439 — APR - Accredited Public Relations Practitioner
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SAQA lists all professional designations registered to the body with their IDs and full titles; use these entries to verify credential names and their official registration numbers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Published professional body web address
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registry entries include a published web address for the professional body to enable further contact or verification via the body's official website.
